purpose: Community Agent Skills tested with the Deep Agents harness. Skill text is not redistributed; fetch it with `python -m infoorgbench_harness fetch-skills --out <dir>`, which verifies each SHA-256.
popularity_source: All-time install counts from the public skills.sh search endpoint, https://skills.sh/api/search?q=<query>&limit=50, retrieved 2026-11-10.
selection_rule: Rank by skills.sh installs the skills that pass both relevance tests, and take the top three. (1) The skill's primary purpose is organizing an existing collection of files or information items into folders or categories by their content. (2) Its guidance does not depend on a particular external application, API key, MCP server or user-specific path. Screening read each candidate's SKILL.md at the commit listed.

skills.name: file-organizer
skills.note: Repository has no license file; the text is fetched, not redistributed.

controls.role: Length-matched irrelevant skill: separates the effect of skill content from the effect of adding a skill of similar length (11,129 bytes versus 11,312 for composio-file-organizer).
controls.name: mcp-builder
controls.note: Only SKILL.md is used; its reference and script files are not provided.
